name: warmproof
description: Keeps Claude Code's one-hour prompt cache warm when you ask (and only in working hours), and proves it: every ping, turn and compaction is logged, and the first message after a pinged break says whether the cache held. Fork pings with no extra turns, per-version pause on a miss, ping cap, daily budget, background-work and self-wake awareness, idle-compaction hold, end-of-window compact or handoff, ntfy alerts with one-time buttons. Profile-aware (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR).

costUnit.title: Show cost as
costUnit.description: tokens (right for a subscription) or usd (API-equivalent list price)

windowHours.title: Keep-warm window (hours)
windowHours.description: How long a bare /keepwarm and /keepwarm always keep pinging

pingEveryMinutes.title: Ping after idle (minutes)
pingEveryMinutes.description: Idle time before each keep-alive ping; must stay under the 60-minute cache lifetime

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context to act on
minContextTokens.description: Below this many context tokens a cold resume is cheap: no guard, no alert, no handoff

workStart.title: Working day starts (HH:MM, local time)
workStart.description: Pings and phone alerts only happen inside working hours

workEnd.title: Working day ends (HH:MM, local time)
workEnd.description: After this time a ping is replaced by the after-hours action

workdaysOnly.title: Weekdays only
workdaysOnly.description: Treat Saturday and Sunday as outside working hours

afterHours.title: Outside working hours
afterHours.description: handoff: stop pinging and save a handoff note; keep-pinging: ignore working hours

handoff.title: Write a handoff note
handoff.description: Save a handoff summary to <profile config dir>/handoffs/ when keep-warm stops after hours

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy topic
ntfyTopic.description: Topic for phone alerts before the cache goes cold; empty turns alerts off. Only the folder name is sent

alertMinutes.title: Alert this many minutes before expiry
alertMinutes.description: Phone alert lead time when keep-warm is off; 0 turns alerts off

blockIdleCompaction.title: Hold idle compaction during keep-warm
blockIdleCompaction.description: While a /keepwarm window is on, skip Claude Code's idle compaction so the context you asked to keep stays whole

autoArmOnColdWrite.title: Keep warm after a cold write
autoArmOnColdWrite.description: After you pay a cold re-write, ping for 3 hours without being asked. Off: pinging only ever starts from /keepwarm

maxPingsPerIdle.title: Most pings per idle stretch
maxPingsPerIdle.description: Stop pinging after this many pings without a real turn

warmDuringBackgroundWork.title: Keep warm while background work runs
warmDuringBackgroundWork.description: Ping automatically while a subagent, background shell or workflow is still running (dev servers and monitors are ignored)

backgroundWarmHours.title: Background keep-warm limit (hours)
backgroundWarmHours.description: Longest automatic window for background work

endOfWindow.title: When a keep-warm window ends
endOfWindow.description: nothing: let it cool; compact: compact once while still warm (big sessions); handoff: save a handoff note

compactMinTokens.title: Compact at window end above (tokens)
compactMinTokens.description: endOfWindow compact only acts on contexts at least this big

dailyPingBudget.title: Daily ping budget (input-equivalent tokens)
dailyPingBudget.description: Across all sessions per local day: reads 0.1x, 1h writes 2x, output 5x. 0 means no cap

ntfyReplyTopic.title: ntfy reply topic (phone buttons)
ntfyReplyTopic.description: A second private topic; when set, phone alerts carry Keep warm 2h / Compact / Leave buttons

showCountdown.title: Always show the cache countdown
showCountdown.description: Show time left on the cache and the cold-resume cost even when no keep-warm window is on

pingSubagentTtl1h.title: Give ping forks the one-hour cache
pingSubagentTtl1h.description: Forks sit in the 5-minute cache bucket by default. On: set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=1h for each ping only, then restore it. Turn on only if the proof test says pings do not hold the cache without it

warmDuringLongTurns.title: Keep warm during long tool runs
warmDuringLongTurns.description: While one turn runs a long command or subagent with no new request, ping before the hour runs out so the cache is still warm when it finishes

desktopNotify.title: Desktop notification when you are at the Mac
desktopNotify.description: Send the before-expiry alert as a macOS notification when you used the keyboard or mouse recently; the phone gets it only when you are away

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes without input)
awayMinutes.description: Keyboard and mouse idle time that counts as away, for choosing phone or desktop

pingOnlyIfWorthIt.title: Ping only when it pays
pingOnlyIfWorthIt.description: Skip a ping when your past breaks say you are unlikely to be back within the next hour (needs 5 logged breaks)

weeklyDigest.title: Weekly digest
weeklyDigest.description: Once a week, send the /warmproof report summary to your phone (ntfy) and save it as a file next to the evidence log

digestWeekday.title: Digest weekday (0 Sunday … 6 Saturday)
digestWeekday.description: Day the weekly digest goes out

digestTime.title: Digest time (HH:MM, local)
digestTime.description: Time the weekly digest goes out

followLeave.title: Join an away plan from another session
followLeave.description: When /warmproof leave is used in any session, this session keeps its warm cache until then too (checked once a minute)

pingOnMeteredBilling.title: Ping on metered billing too
pingOnMeteredBilling.description: API key, relay, Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry sessions bill per token and cache for 5 minutes, so pings are off there. On: ping anyway

pauseAbovePlanPercent.title: Pause pinging above this plan usage (%)
pauseAbovePlanPercent.description: Stop pinging once any plan limit reaches this percentage, keeping the rest of your allowance for real work; 0 turns the check off

evidenceMaxKb.title: Roll the evidence log above (KB)
evidenceMaxKb.description: A session's evidence file is rolled into <session>.1.jsonl past this size, so a long session cannot grow without limit; 0 never rolls

denyToolsDuringPing.title: Refuse tool calls while a ping is in flight
denyToolsDuringPing.description: A keep-warm ping asks for one word and must never act. Calls from another loop are refused for the second or so a ping takes; your own tools are never affected
